text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Total screw-up~~. Getting injured is such 
a drag.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, it doesn't hurt that bad, y'know? 
Can I head back to training now?
choice_data_list:
Pushing yourself too hard isn't good for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It's not impossible. I'm telling you 
I can do it, aren't I?
choice_data_list:
Then let's try it without pushing 
ourselves too hard.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What, are you scared? I told you it's 
totally fine~~.
choice_data_list:
We'll focus on classroom lessons until 
your injury heals.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wha!? Is that what this is about?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe the other way around? Like, she 
only studies when she literally can't move 
around?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way~! I hate, hate studying! I'm gonna 
get better super fast!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan took it easy and rested, 
properly healing her injury.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy~! Love the energy! Well then, let's 
hit the track, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Crap... maybe it really does hurt after 
all...? No way, Jordon, that hurts like 
hell...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning to training seems difficult for 
now. It would be best to focus on resting 
after all...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! How's that? Nothin' to complain 
about now, right?
choice_data_list:
Let's keep going. Just don't push yourself 
too hard.

Let's keep going. Just don't push yourself 
too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So persistent~. If you keep watching me, I 
won't be able to do anything reckless even 
if I want to.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Well? So does that mean you can rest 
easy? Kind of thing, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tosen Jordan successfully made her 
comeback.
